comparison_rules: Cache budget,process dedicated bytes,whole-card use and card capacity differ.
Long30K batched prefill cannot be compared directly to1–28 actual evaluated cached-tail tokens.
A fresh KV prefix can still have warm expert/OS caches;native warmup also changes expert state.
Speculative accepted tokens per verify differ from non-speculative one-token decoding.
Quant differences are material,not a sufficient stand-alone explanation for the public speed gap.
Logical uploaded MiB/wall is not hardware PCIe bandwidth or measured physical bytes.
Current pressure-conditioned mmap/read viability is not clean per-transfer causal partition or actual VRChat co-rendering.
